translationRepairs: Lou Jing said: 'Your Majesty took all-under-heaven differs from Zhou house.
Lou Jing said: 'Your Majesty took all-under-heaven differently from the Zhou house.

Focus Chinese 取天下與周室異 contrasts how the empire was obtained with the Zhou house. The original literal "took all-under-heaven differs" is ungrammatical; "differently from the Zhou house" restores that contrast without changing speaker or sense.
He was defeated at Dingtao and followed the Huai King.
After the defeat at Dingtao, he followed the Huai King.

Preceding unit has Shusun Tong follow Xiang Liang; 敗於定陶，從懷王 then marks the Dingtao defeat as circumstance before he follows King Huai. "He was defeated" wrongly makes Shusun the defeated party; "After the defeat at Dingtao, he followed the Huai King" keeps the biography's subject as follower only.
When Shusun Tong went out, he gave each of the scholars five hundred jin of gold.
When Shusun Tong went out, he gave the five hundred jin of gold to the scholars.

皆以五百斤金賜諸生 means he used that five-hundred-jin sum to reward the scholars, not that each received five hundred jin. Removing "each of" corrects the quantity error while matching the narrative and idiomatic sense.
He then went, arrived at Pingcheng, and the Xiongnu indeed sent crack troops that surrounded the Gao Emperor at Baiteng. Only after seven days did he get release.
He then went, arrived at Pingcheng, and the Xiongnu indeed sent crack troops that surrounded the Gao Emperor at Baideng. Only after seven days did he get release.
白登 is Baideng; "Baiteng" is a wrong romanization of the same place name. The proposed literal only corrects that reading and leaves the siege narrative intact.
